rules.title: Shops with homes above
rules.plain: NC-S lots are for neighborhood shopping centers, with homes allowed: up to one home per 800 square feet of lot area, or the density of the nearest residential district if that is greater (that comparison isn't shown).

rules.title: Where height is measured from
rules.plain: Height is measured from the curb at the middle of the building's street front. On a lot that slopes up from the street, only the first 10 feet back are measured from the curb, and the rest from the average ground at the two sides of each cross-section; on a lot that slopes down, the curb is used for the first 100 feet.

rules.title: Height limit
rules.plain: No part of a building may be taller than the height limit mapped for this lot's height and bulk district.

rules.title: Ground floor height
rules.plain: A shop or other non-residential ground floor must be at least 14 feet from floor to floor, or 10 feet in 40- and 50-foot height districts.

rules.title: Rear yard
rules.plain: The back 25% of the lot, and never less than 15 feet, must stay open from the second story up, and at ground level too if the first story has homes.

rules.title: Floor area for non-residential uses
rules.plain: Shops, offices and other non-residential uses may have floor area up to 1.8 times the lot area; homes don't count toward this limit.

rules.title: Sidewalk setback
rules.plain: Where the sidewalk is narrower than the Better Streets Plan recommends, a lot with 50 feet or more of frontage, a corner lot or a lot next to a set-back building must set its first 15 feet of height back to widen the sidewalk; sidewalk widths aren't in this app's data.

rules.title: Narrow streets
rules.plain: On a street 40 feet wide or narrower, upper stories may have to step back from the front; street widths aren't in this app's data, so that isn't shown.

rules.title: Cross-slope
rules.plain: Where the street or the ground slopes across the lot by more than 5%, a wide building is measured from several points, each covering a limited width (65 feet or less, narrower on steeper slopes); this view measures from one point.

rules.title: Bulk limits
rules.plain: Where the lot's height and bulk district has a letter other than X (such as 65-A), upper floors are limited in length and diagonal; those limits aren't applied here yet.

rules.title: Large lots
rules.plain: On a lot of two acres or more, a limit of 65% lot coverage from the second story up, with 35% of the lot left unbuilt, replaces the rear yard; that isn't shown.
